text.label: invisible hatchery
text.description: Main source of larvae. Everyone starts with one, and no one can buy more. No one knows they have it, because it's invisible.
text.lol: Stop digging around in the source code, you dirty cheater.

text.label: meat
text.description: All of your swarm's creatures eat meat.
text.lol: These days, the most enlightened and best-looking swarms prefer meat substitutes. Which swarms are those, you ask? Don’t worry, they’ll tell you.

text.label: larva
text.description: The children of your swarm. These young creatures morph into other adult units.
text.lol: Why not "larvas", English?

text.label: cocoon
text.lol: Enemy COCOON used HARDEN!

text.description: spent-energy consumed for respecs. affects ascension cost.

text.label: energy and max energy
text.description: energy bought with microtransactions also permanently increases max energy. Don't wanna worry about hitting the cap.

text.label: nexus
text.lol: There was a lot more to magic, as Hairy quickly found out, than waving your antennae and saying a few funny words.

text.label: drone
text.description: Drones are the lowest class of worker in your swarm. They continuously gather meat to feed your swarm.
text.lol: Not to be confused with probes or mules.

text.label: queen
text.description: Queens rule over your swarm's workers.
text.lol: I want to ride my bicycle / I want to ride my bike / I want to ride my bicycle / I want to ride it where I like

text.label: nest
text.description: Nests provide space and support for your swarm's queens.
text.lol: They also have fancy temperature controls.

warnfirst.text: Your first nest will take a long time to regenerate the queens sacrificed to build it. Consider hatching more queens first.

text.label: greater queen
text.description: Greater queens rule over the lesser queens of very large swarms.
text.lol: Can't think of a name? Pick another creature and slap "greater" in front of it!

warnfirst.text: Your first few greater queens will take a long time to regenerate the nests sacrificed to build them. Consider building more nests first.

text.label: hive
text.description: Hives are huge structures crafted from meat and the bodies of thousands of queens. They allow your swarm to grow even faster.
text.lol: Serve the hive. Feel the groove. I control the way you move.

warnfirst.text: Your first few hives will take a long time to regenerate the greater queens sacrificed to build them. Consider hatching more greater queens first.

text.label: hive queen
text.description: Hive queens oversee the production of hives in the largest swarms.
text.lol: Managers managing managers managing managers.

warnfirst.text: Your first few hive queens will take a long time to regenerate the hives sacrificed to build them. Consider building more hives first.

text.label: hive empress
text.description: The mightiest creature to rule over your swarm so far.
text.lol: On her thorax and on her forewing she has this name written: queen of queens and lady of ladies.

text.label: neuroprophet
text.description: Your prophets foresee the guidance of a higher power, a greater being - yet, the heavens have fallen silent.
text.lol: Heavens and goddesses and pantheons never really made much sense for a swarm, did they?

text.label: hive neuron
text.description: Neurons are the building blocks of a greater hive intelligence.
text.lol: Thanks, Neuronerd. Miss you.

text.label: neural cluster
text.description: Groups of neurons begin to exert mild psychic powers, influencing the minds of lesser creatures in your swarm.
text.lol: Their trick for avoiding cluster headaches is to avoid having a head.

text.label: hive network
text.description: Networking your hive's neurons allows them to coordinate their actions, much as a single entity would.
text.lol: Networks also allow them to play games and watch videos of ...uh, cats.

text.label: lesser hive mind
text.description: Your neural networks have finally formed a single greater intelligence, primitive though it may be. The psychic powers of lesser hive minds are great enough to directly control several hundred lesser members of your swarm.
text.lol: Hey, "lesser" works just as well as "greater" for naming things!

text.label: hive mind
text.description: Mature hive minds control thousands of lesser members of your swarm, and their capacity for intelligent planning is dramatically improved.
text.lol: Do hive minds have hives on their minds? Sounds painful.

text.label: arch-mind
text.description: Multiple hive minds merge their collective consciousness into a single greater being.
text.lol: By your powers combined...

text.label: overmind
text.description: The Overmind psychically controls the actions of every member of your swarm, including all of the lesser hive minds. Building more physical manifestations of the Overmind merely increases its influence; all belong to the same being, the same greater intelligence. Your swarm now exists to serve the will of its Overmind.
text.lol: SO much cooler than that infested human, even if she did win.

text.label: overmind II
text.description: Eternity lies ahead of us, and behind. Have you drunk your fill?
text.lol: And here's where I ran out of ideas.

text.description: Eternity lies ahead of us, and behind. Have you drunk your fill?

text.label: swarmling
text.description: Your swarm's smallest and weakest warriors. They use their teeth and claws to attack foes, and can be vicious in large numbers.
text.lol: Groups of six at the wrong time are pretty vicious too.

text.label: stinger
text.description: Weak flying warriors. They roam in packs, attacking any threats with venomous stingers.
text.lol: Reasonably smart critters - they consistently earn a 3.0 GPA.

text.label: arachnomorph
text.description: Terrifying eight-legged beasts who leap upon their prey, ensnare it in sticky traps, and finally liquify it into a delicious beverage.
text.lol: Four legs good. Eight legs better.

text.label: culicimorph
text.description: These hated creatures feast on the blood of their victims, and spread disease to larger prey they cannot kill outright.
text.lol: These guys really suck.

text.label: locust
text.description: Groups of hungry locusts devour any creature that makes the mistake of standing in their way.
text.lol: Preceded by fiery hail, followed by darkness.

text.label: roach
text.description: The hard shell of the roach makes it a fearsome opponent; it is nearly impossible to kill.
text.lol: ROOSTERS.

text.label: giant arachnomorph
text.description: The larger, and more fearsome, cousin of the arachnomorph.
text.lol: Rest assured that you do not swallow eight of these per year while sleeping.

text.label: chilopodomorph
text.description: Swift wormlike creatures with hundreds of legs and an extremely venomous bite.
text.lol: Hi Mom!

text.label: wasp
text.description: An advanced cousin of the stinger, wasps are far more aggressive and much better hunters.
text.lol: I can't beelieve you're actually reading this.

text.label: devourer
text.description: Huge burrowing worms, devourers appear from beneath the earth to swallow their prey before it can react.
text.lol: Extra fun in hardcore leagues and fractured maps.

text.label: goon
text.description: Goons cannot fly on their own, but instead use metal to construct powerful flying exoskeletons that rule the skies.
text.lol: They like spreadsheets too.

text.label: nightbug
text.lol: Often seen in the company of an ice fairy, a singing sparrow, and a ball of darkness.

text.label: lepidoptera
text.lol: on the one ton temple bell / a moon-moth, folded into sleep, / sits still.

text.label: bat
text.lol: "Bats aren't bugs!!" "Look, who's giving this report? You chowderheads... or me?!"

text.lol: Savescumming won't work, by the way.

text.label: cocooning
text.description: Allows your larvae to encase themselves within cocoons. Cocooned larvae cannot mutate into other units, and can still be cloned by Clone Larvae. You may cocoon and uncocoon your larvae whenever you wish.
